AccountingStartImpact.description:
What moving the start of the accounting does (all centre-wide, today): new debts AND changes of the advance / of what
can be refunded (an earlier start charges more, so advances shrink).
AccountingStartImpact.title: AccountingStartImpact

AddStudentToGroupRequest.description:
Optional body of "add a student to a group".

Without a body the student follows the price of the group.  ``price_override`` is an explicit individual
price (sum + reason) and needs the right to manage payments.
AddStudentToGroupRequest.title: AddStudentToGroupRequest

Allocation.description: A piece of one payment in one segment ("where the money went").
Allocation.title: Allocation

AllocationSummary.description: What a just entered payment did (``PaymentCreated.allocation``).
AllocationSummary.title: AllocationSummary

ArchivedGroupOut.description: A group the student was removed from by the last archiving (the return window offers it again).
ArchivedGroupOut.title: ArchivedGroupOut

CarriedFromOut.description: The payment a carry-over (N13 P2.1) was made from, and the group it belonged to.
CarriedFromOut.title: CarriedFromOut

CarriedOutOut.description: The payment moved to another group with the student on ``date`` (business date, N13 P2.1).
CarriedOutOut.title: CarriedOutOut

GroupPriceCancelled.description: A scheduled group price that was taken back (``DELETE /org/groups/{id}/prices/{row_id}``): the row is gone.
GroupPriceCancelled.title: GroupPriceCancelled

GroupPriceChange.description: One write of the price of a day (the audit trail, ``group_audit``): who, when, from what to what.
GroupPriceChange.title: GroupPriceChange

GroupPriceChanged.description: ``PUT /org/groups/{id}/price``: the new state + the impact; with ``?dry_run=1`` only the impact.
GroupPriceChanged.title: GroupPriceChanged

ImpactMoney.description: The money effect of a change of one membership (the ledger before / after, same day).
ImpactMoney.title: ImpactMoney

LineOverride.description:
A change of one line (membership) of a sheet.

``include_unpaid``: absent leaves it as it is.  ``monthly_fee``: the price is NOT edited on a sheet any more (UX-2,
owner decision) - a number is refused with 422 ``PRICE_NOT_EDITABLE`` (the price comes from «Цены групп» or from
the card of the student); ``null`` is accepted and means "no manual price" (drops a manual price of an old sheet).
LineOverride.title: LineOverride

LogicAErrorDetail.description:
Error body of the LOGIC-A endpoints: ``PayErrorDetail`` + the lists some codes carry.

Codes: ``OPENING_RANGE`` / ``PAUSE_RANGE`` / ``PAUSE_LOCKED`` / ``NOTHING_TO_PAY`` / ``PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_DEBT`` (``debt``) /
``LESSON_TYPE_RANGE`` / ``METHOD_REQUIRED`` / ``REASON_REQUIRED`` (422); ``OPENING_NOT_ALLOWED`` / ``PAUSE_OVERLAP`` /
``PAUSE_OVERLAPS_ATTENDED`` (``dates``) / ``PAUSE_BREAKS_REFUND`` / ``MEMBERSHIP_CLOSED`` / ``BALANCE_CHANGED`` (``fresh``) /
``PRICE_BACKDATE_WITH_PAYMENTS`` (``students``) / ``PRICE_MARKER`` / ``PRICE_CONFLICT`` / ``VOID_BREAKS_REFUND`` (409).
LogicAErrorDetail.title: LogicAErrorDetail

OpeningIn.description: The opening balance of a membership: «оплачено до» and / or «долг X на дату T» (the debt needs its date).
OpeningIn.title: OpeningIn

OpeningPut.description:
``PUT /org/memberships/{id}/opening-balance``: all three empty = void of the live one.  ``reason`` is required
(3..500) when the membership already has money, write-offs or refunds.
OpeningPut.title: OpeningPut

OpeningSaved.description: ``opening`` null: the call voided the live one (or ``dry_run`` of such a call).
OpeningSaved.title: OpeningSaved

PauseVoid.description: Cancel a pause: the reason 3..500 characters.
PauseVoid.title: PauseVoid

PayErrorDetail.description:
``{"detail": {...}}`` of an error (``PriceError`` / ``PaymentError`` with a code).

Codes: ``DUPLICATE_PAYMENT`` (409), ``STUDENT_ARCHIVED`` (409), ``ALREADY_VOIDED`` (409), ``VOID_BREAKS_REFUND``
(409), ``CONCURRENT_EDIT`` (409), ``AMOUNT_RANGE`` (422), ``PAID_ON_RANGE`` (422), ``METHOD_REQUIRED`` (422),
``REASON_REQUIRED`` (422), ``WRITEOFF_EXCEEDS_DEBT`` (422, ``debt``), ``REFUND_EXCEEDS_ADVANCE`` (422,
``refundable``), ``ACCOUNTING_START_RANGE`` (422), ``RANGE_TOO_LONG`` (422).  403 / 404 carry a plain message.
PayErrorDetail.title: PayErrorDetail

PaymentAllocationOut.description: The CURRENT (factual) distribution of a payment, ``PaymentOut.allocation``.
PaymentAllocationOut.title: PaymentAllocationOut

PaymentCreate.description:
PAY-2: amount only.  ``amount`` 1..``MAX_MONEY`` (422 ``AMOUNT_RANGE``), ``paid_on`` not in the future and not older
than 3 years (422 ``PAID_ON_RANGE``).  ``method``: absent -> ``other`` (old front, one release); ``unknown`` ->
422 ``METHOD_REQUIRED``.  ``valid_from`` / ``valid_to`` / ``lessons_count`` are accepted and IGNORED (one release).
The header ``Idempotency-Key: <uuid>``: a second POST with the same key creates nothing and answers 409
``DUPLICATE_PAYMENT`` whose detail carries ``payment_id`` of the payment the first call created.
PaymentCreate.title: PaymentCreate

PaymentCreated.description: PAY-2: ``allocation`` (where the money went) is always filled by the server.
PaymentCreated.title: PaymentCreated

PaymentFileOut.description: A photo / scan of the cheque attached to a payment (the bytes are served by their own endpoint).
PaymentFileOut.title: PaymentFileOut

PaymentSettingsChanged.description:
``PUT /org/settings/payments``.  ``?dry_run=true`` writes nothing: the CURRENT settings + the impact of the
requested ``accounting_start_date`` (``impact``); a real write returns the new settings and ``impact`` null.
PaymentSettingsChanged.title: PaymentSettingsChanged

PaymentSettingsUpdate.description: PATCH semantics: a field that is absent (or null) stays as it was.
PaymentSettingsUpdate.title: PaymentSettingsUpdate

PaymentsBuckets.description: Memberships per tab of the payments page (the same sets ``GET /org/payments/status?bucket=`` lists).
PaymentsBuckets.title: PaymentsBuckets

PayoutCreate.description:
``amount`` 1..10^10 (422 ``AMOUNT_RANGE``); ``paid_on`` default today, not in the future, not older than 3 years
(422 ``PAID_ON_RANGE``); ``method`` mandatory (422 ``METHOD_REQUIRED``).
PayoutCreate.title: PayoutCreate

PayoutState.description:
``target`` = ``fresh_total`` when the sheet is stale (``basis="fresh"``), else the saved total (``basis="saved"``;
``fresh_total`` null when there is no rate / a manual price); ``balance = target - paid`` (negative = overpaid).
PayoutState.title: PayoutState

PayrollSettings.description:
LOGIC-A (F7): the divisor is a history by month (like the rates).  ``divisor`` / ``valid_from`` - the one of the
current month; ``history`` - every row, oldest first (the seed row of the migration is ``2020-01``).
PayrollSettings.title: PayrollSettings

PayrollSettingsUpdate.description: 422 ``DIVISOR_RANGE`` outside 1..31; ``valid_from`` "YYYY-MM" (default: the current month, not before 2020-01).
PayrollSettingsUpdate.title: PayrollSettingsUpdate

PreviewDue.description: What the student owes today (before the typed amount).
PreviewDue.title: PreviewDue

PreviewLessons.description: Lessons mode: what the money buys in lessons.
PreviewLessons.title: PreviewLessons

PriceAhead.description:
A period the advance reaches whose price differs from today's price (D8: a scheduled price change makes the
same money buy fewer / more days).
PriceAhead.title: PriceAhead

PriceImpact.description: What a change of the group price touches.  Payments already entered never change.
PriceImpact.title: PriceImpact

PriceOut.description:
The effective price of a membership on a day (ROADMAP #105, ``src/auth/pricing.py``).

``source``: ``group`` - the price of the group; ``override`` - the individual price of the student (then
``reason`` says why and ``group_amount`` is what the group price would be); ``none`` - not set anywhere.
``valid_from`` - the day the row that gave the price started.  The sum means "Оплата в месяц" (calendar
periods) or "Стоимость пакета" (lesson packages) as the centre's billing mode says.
PriceOut.title: PriceOut

PriceOverrideCancelled.description: A scheduled individual price that was taken back (``DELETE /org/memberships/{id}/price-override/{row_id}``).
PriceOverrideCancelled.title: PriceOverrideCancelled

PriceOverrideChange.description: One write of the individual price of a day (the audit trail, ``group_audit``).
PriceOverrideChange.title: PriceOverrideChange

PriceOverrideInput.description: An individual price given together with the enrolment (ROADMAP #105): a sum and the reason, both mandatory.
PriceOverrideInput.title: PriceOverrideInput

PriceOverrideUpdate.description:
``amount`` a sum: the individual price from ``valid_from`` (``reason`` 3..200 characters is mandatory);
``amount`` null: from that day the price of the group again (``reason`` optional).
PriceOverrideUpdate.title: PriceOverrideUpdate

PriceStepOut.description: The price of a line changed inside the month: ``date`` is the first lesson day with this price.
PriceStepOut.title: PriceStepOut

RecordVoid.description: Cancel a write-off / a refund: the reason 3..500 characters.
RecordVoid.title: RecordVoid

Segment.description: One charge: a period of the student in the group (or a lessons package).
Segment.title: Segment

SegmentLessons.description: A period prorated by the lessons of the group: lessons in the charged part / in the whole period.
SegmentLessons.title: SegmentLessons

SheetCreate.description: Save a sheet; if the teacher already has one for the month this is its next revision.
SheetCreate.title: SheetCreate

SheetOut.description: A saved sheet (``id`` set) or a preview (``saved`` false, nothing is written).
SheetOut.title: SheetOut

StatementDetails.description: The part of a row that depends on its ``type`` (the other fields are null).
StatementDetails.title: StatementDetails

StatementOut.description:
``GET /org/memberships/{id}/statement``.  The last row's ``balance_after`` equals ``summary.advance - summary.debt``
(rows cut by ``from`` / ``to`` keep the running total of the whole history).
StatementOut.title: StatementOut

StatementSummary.description: Always for the whole accounting period up to today, whatever ``from`` / ``to`` the rows were cut by.
StatementSummary.title: StatementSummary

put.description:
Задать цену группы: сумма + «действует с» (по умолчанию сегодня; прошлая дата разрешена) + примечание.

В ответе — новая история и ``impact``: сколько учеников возьмут цену (``students_following``), у скольких
индивидуальная (``students_with_override``) и сколько сохранённых ведомостей зарплаты станут «данные изменились»
(``stale_payroll_sheets``; их список ``stale_sheets`` — только владельцу). ``?dry_run=1`` — только ``impact``.
LOGIC-A: ``impact.money`` - что изменится у денег (долг / аванс / «оплачено до»); цена задним числом, которая меняет начисление
уже начавшегося периода у ученика с оплатами, - 409 ``PRICE_BACKDATE_WITH_PAYMENTS``.

Каждая запись (новая, исправление той же даты) оставляет строку аудита (``group_audit``, ``group_price_set``) в той
же транзакции — она видна в ``history[].changes``. Тот же запрос ещё раз (двойной клик: сумма, примечание и
``valid_from`` те же) ничего не меняет и вторую строку аудита не пишет.
